events.continuity_hook: Follows the Minneapolis hotel decision with the airfare selection needed to finish the trip plan.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the remaining round trips by fare, carrier, elapsed time, arrival buffer, Friday airport margin, and Chicago arrival time, then identify the itinerary to ticket.
events.scenario_brief: With the Minneapolis event hotel now held before the block deadline, Marisol turns to airfare for the May 19-21 board committee trip. The Wednesday opening dinner is at 6:30 p.m., Friday committee breakouts may run until 1:00 p.m., and she will not rent a car. Current constraints are arriving from Chicago with enough margin to check in before dinner, returning Friday after lunch without getting home late, and avoiding a fare premium for an earlier return she cannot use. The unresolved choice is between a well-timed United nonstop pair and cheaper options with later Friday arrivals back in Chicago.

events.continuity_hook: Checks Minneapolis travel details after both the hotel and flights are in place.
events.interaction_goal: Map the arrival and departure timing, confirm hotel bag storage and room basics, note breakfast and nearby dining options, and flag whether the current return still has enough airport margin.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the Minneapolis trip, board staff send a final note that Friday breakouts will likely end at 12:45 p.m. instead of 1:00, and the hotel confirms bag storage but no included breakfast. Current constraints are leaving the morning simple, using light rail or a rideshare from MSP depending on luggage and weather, keeping the Friday after-lunch return intact, and knowing where she can get coffee and a quick meal near the meeting rooms. Nothing needs to be rebooked yet, but she wants the door-to-door timing checked.

events.continuity_hook: Begins a personal weekend after the Minneapolis board trip is wrapped.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact hotel comparison with estimated total cost, walkability from the train and museum, breakfast availability, in-room coffee and refrigerator details, nearby dinner choices, cancellation terms, and the best room type to hold.
events.scenario_brief: After the spring work travel run, Marisol starts planning a low-key June 25-27 Milwaukee weekend with her spouse for a Saturday afternoon museum exhibit and Sunday brunch with her sister. They expect to take the train from Chicago after work Friday and avoid a car once there. Current constraints are a walkable hotel near the lakefront, Third Ward, or the station; a moderate two-night total; a comfortable standard one-bed room; and easy breakfast or coffee before the museum. The unresolved question is whether the better location is worth more than a practical limited-service stay a few blocks farther out.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Milwaukee weekend after exhibit timing and family plans settle.
events.interaction_goal: Update the hotel comparison around the new museum and brunch timing, show likely local transportation needs, check room and breakfast details, and recommend whether to keep or change the refundable reservation.
events.scenario_brief: The Milwaukee museum timed entry shifts to late Saturday morning, and Marisol's sister can only meet for brunch in Bay View on Sunday at 10:30 a.m. The train times are workable, but Friday arrival will be close to 8:00 p.m. Current constraints are keeping dinner easy after arrival, not adding unnecessary rideshares, and staying within the cancellation window for the first hotel hold. The unresolved choice is whether to keep the lakefront hotel or switch to a slightly cheaper Third Ward property with a simpler breakfast setup.

events.continuity_hook: Starts the next professional travel episode after the Milwaukee personal weekend plan is settled.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact comparison of Chicago-Denver flight and hotel pairings with estimated totals, arrival and return timing, airport transfer assumptions, meeting access, breakfast details, room basics, dinner options, and cancellation terms.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol begins planning an August 24-26 Denver regional arts data convening with a Tuesday evening opening reception downtown, a Wednesday full-day session near the convention center, and a Thursday grantmaker roundtable expected to end at noon. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, avoiding a rental car, deciding between the conference hotel block and nearby lower-priced hotels, and returning Thursday after lunch without stretching the trip into the evening. No bookings exist, and the main unresolved issue is whether the block hotel convenience outweighs a cheaper stay that includes breakfast.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows Denver lodging before the hotel block deadline and before airfare is finalized.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the final hotel choices by total cost, walking and rideshare time, breakfast value, room amenities, cancellation cutoff, evening dining access, and any return-flight timing implication from the later Thursday finish.
events.scenario_brief: The Denver organizer confirms that Wednesday's networking reception will be in RiNo, while Thursday's roundtable may run until 12:45 p.m.; the conference hotel block closes in three days. Current constraints are keeping the mornings easy, leaving enough time for a Thursday after-lunch flight, finding a defensible lodging total, and checking whether the off-block hotels have in-room coffee, a mini-fridge, and a standard one-bed room available. The unresolved choice is the conference hotel with the shortest meeting walk versus a nearby limited-service hotel with breakfast and a lower total.
